artifact_observations.reasoning: The left edge of the breastplate shows slight softness and blending into the white background, lacking the crisp hard-edge definition expected of rigid metal.
The lacing/straps on the right side appear somewhat indistinct and 'mushy,' lacking clear mechanical definition or distinct holes for laces.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of armor and distinguish it from generic vests or costumes.
To verify the rigidity of the metal edges and ensure no floating artifacts or background bleeding.
To analyze the realism of the specular highlights and detect any texture smearing on the reflective surface.

focus_areas: Edge sharpness of the metal plate against the background
Clarity and mechanical logic of the side lacing/straps
Consistency of specular highlights with the curved geometry
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the side lacing mechanism; AI often struggles with complex interlocking parts like straps and buckles, resulting in fused or nonsensical structures. Also, verify if the 'embossed' details look like actual depth or just painted-on noise.
